detail: Acquisition - QMS Medical Allied Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition by additional stake of 24% in Saarathi Healthcare Private Limited, a Subsidiary of the Company. Pursuant to the said acquisition the Company now holds 100% in Saarathi Healthcare Private Limited
